thread:
simon: Pager triage — hosted-api 5xx spike (2% -> 18%) after canary rollout at 08:14 UTC. Canary group: us-east-1. New env var and KMS key rotated in deploy.
incident-bot: AUTOMATED: Pager created for service=hosted-api severity=high; 5xx_rate=18%; affected_routes=[/v1/generate,/v1/chat].
morgan: I'm on it. Paging rotation -> I'm primary oncall. Any rollback/kill plan?
simon: FYI deploy pipeline: release/2.3.1 -> applied env var NEW_KMS_KEY=arn:aws:kms:...:key/rotated-key-id; feature flag 'kms-new-key' enabled for canary only.
carla: seeing decrypt errors in pod logs: `AccessDeniedException: Not authorized to decrypt with key-id arn:aws:kms:...:rotated-key-id` — looks like role hasn't got kms:Decrypt on new key.
morgan: that matches. Canary instances failing to decrypt model keys -> returning 500. Quick mitigation: disable 'kms-new-key' flag or rollback canary. Which is faster?
simon: kill-switch flag is fastest. I can flip it in Console. Command for rollback if needed:
```
# rollback canary
kubectl -n production rollout undo deployment/hosted-api --to-revision=122
```
morgan: flip flag first. simon, can you set `kms-new-key` -> off for canary group? I'll monitor.
simon: doing now -> POST https://console.internal/flags/kms-new-key -> {"enabled":false, "scope":"canary"}
ops-bot: FLAG_CHANGE: user=simon flag=kms-new-key scope=canary result=success
morgan: metrics updating — 5xx dropping from 18% -> 3% in 2 minutes. Starting slow rollback for canary replicas to 2.3.0 as precaution.
carla: opened IAM request for team infra to add kms:Decrypt for redwood-prod-role on rotated-key-id; filing ticket INT-4792.
alex: taking over oncall for next shift; handoff: monitoring logs and IAM ticket. Current status: kill-switch flipped, partial rollback started, backend errors reduced. Escalate if 5xx > 5%.
kate: customer impact estimate — 08:14–08:23 UTC approx 9 minutes of elevated errors for ~4% of requests globally; small subset of enterprise customers in us-east had retries/failures. Notifying CSMs.
morgan: updating incident board, marking mitigation=flag-kill and rollback-in-progress. Will keep incident open until IAM fix and full rollout validated.
incident-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE: severity lowered to medium; mitigation in place. next_update=+30m
alex: ACK, I'll follow through and confirm when IAM change applied and new canary pass. Handoff complete.
